title: Fox Client 1.1.0 — Shulker Tooltips, Low Fire, Low Shield
body: Shulker boxes now show a compact stack count on Shift and a full 9×3 visual grid on Alt+Shift. Low Fire shifts the overlay to the bottom strip instead of removing it. Low Shield hides the shield raise animation on the offhand. GrimAC compatibility audit: all modules clean.

title: Recommended Pack updated
body: The launcher's recommended mod pack now includes Simple Voice Chat, EMF, ETF, AppleSkin, Chat Heads, Jade, Axiom, and Mod Menu. Hit "Install full recommended pack" in Profiles → Mods & Addons to grab them.

title: Welcome to Fox Launcher
body: Fox Launcher is live. Profiles, isolated instances, per-profile mod toggles, screenshot gallery, and one-click play. Sign in with your Microsoft account and hit PLAY to get started.
